module: VMware Java JCE (Java Cryptographic Extension) Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. The module generates cryptographic keys whose strengths are modified by available entropy. No assurance of the minimum strength of generated keys
description: The VMware Java JCE (Java Cryptographic Extension) Module is a software cryptographic module based on the Legion of the Bouncy Castle Inc. FIPS Java API (BC-FJA) Module (SW Version 1.0.0). The module is a software library that provides cryptographic functions to various VMware applications via a well-defined Java-language application program interface (API).
